scripts.build: npm run build -w bridge && vite build
scripts.deploy:self: node scripts/make-self-config.mjs && WRANGLER_CONFIG=wrangler.self.jsonc npm run build && wrangler deploy

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Encrypts your stored model-provider keys at rest. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

AUTH_SECRET.description: HMAC key that signs the login session cookie. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

APP_PASSWORD.description: The password you will log in with. Pick a strong one; anyone who knows it can use your instance.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email address. Seeded as the instance owner (admin) so you can invite members later. Optional: leave blank to run as the default password-gate owner.

STORE.description: R2 bucket for file uploads and app storage.

BACKUP_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for workspace snapshots, so session workspaces survive container sleep.

APP_NAME.description: Display name shown in the app UI. Leave as Agents unless you want your own branding.

WORKER_NAME.description: Name of the Worker on your account. Leave as is unless you run more than one instance.
